name: Amanogawa Karina
source:
Birthday: July 7 (Her real date of birth is unknown, this is the day when she was picked up).
Hobbies: Counting money
Favorite food: Money ♪
[url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/D%C5%8Dbutsu_uranai]Zoological fortune-telling[/url]: Black leopard.

Youngest (3rd) daughter. 1st year student at Akahoshi Academy.
